'''jedimaster Court is in Session''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[jedimaster]]
* '''Published:''' 12 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Vile jedimaster DS 2003 Courtisi.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My first attempt @ a COTVG deck..all input welcome.

The published list has 56 cards.

== Strategy ==

Pretty basic COTVG deck.

The CC Fett will soon be replaced with a Fett, BH and two more Trap Doors will be in the deck soon. MJ will also soon be an Arica.

Thinking about taking out the following cards...no use for them really...thinking of adding 2 more Trap Doors and a Hidden Weapons in their place

Tatooine

Executor

Dominator

All comment welcome!

Card choices and reasons...

Imperial Barrier/None Shall Pass = provides a good way of preventing beatdowns and stalling your opponent.

Chall Bekan = deploy to Audience Chamber using its game text then use Chall to pull Rodian (V) so BH cost less to deploy.

Mosep = coolest little dude ever. Place him in middle site at JP and watch your opponents reserve deck disappear.

Ability, Ability, Ability = great for steady force loss, with your 19 Characters you should never have to lose Force.

Mighty Jabba = for times when you need that battle destiny

Jabba = makes S & V immune to Alter while @ Audience Chamber

Jodo Kast, Boba Fett, and anyone + Mandalorian Armor = gives you three characters that can use Hidden Weapons.
